_comment: Codex PreToolUse guards. Codex passes {tool_name, tool_input.command, cwd} on stdin and reads back {hookSpecificOutput:{permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason}} — the exact shape bin/guard-*.mjs already emit for Claude Code, so the guards are reused verbatim. Paths resolve from the git root because Codex runs hooks with the (unstable) session cwd. install-codex.sh rewrites these to absolute ~/.codex/bin paths for a global install.
